description: Takes the list of savings initiatives with identified, signed (contracted) and realised values and whether the saving reached the budget or P&L (yes, no or an amount), and returns the funnel totals, how many euros of every 100 identified arrive in the budget or P&L, the three gaps (not contracted, signed but not realised, realised but not booked), totals by category and owner, and flags per initiative (realised above contract, marked realised without amount, signed over six months ago with nothing realised, no owner, no baseline). German or English column names are recognised (Maßnahme, Warengruppe, Verantwortlich, Baseline, erkannt, unterschrieben, realisiert, in_budget, Vertragsdatum, Status). Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

initiatives.description: Initiative rows: initiative, category, owner, baseline, identified, signed, realised, in_budget (yes, no or amount), signed_date, stage.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name: track_value
title: Prove savings: identified, signed, realised and what actually reached the budget or P&L, with the gaps in euros
